answer: Farming becomes a pearl bet on surviving 57 epochs of grading, and every comet settlement recomputes the sonnet schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 57 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 19 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
